# AI Suede Podcast
> Podcast feed from Jason Colapietro on Suede AI, creator ownership, music IP, programmable media, and solo founder shipping.

## Main sections
- [Podcast home](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/): Episode artwork, description, and links to listen.
- [Appearances](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/appearances): Guest appearances on other people's podcasts, AMAs and Spaces, grouped by host show.
- [RSS feed](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/feed.xml): Full episode feed for podcast apps.
- [Full text](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/llms-full.txt): Every episode's show notes, the topic hubs and the appearances index in one Markdown file.
- [About](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/about): The show, its host Jason Colapietro, and where to listen.
- [Contact](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/contact): Guest booking, interview requests and press.
- [Notes](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/notes): Articles from Jason Colapietro and Suede AI, written in West Palm Beach, Florida, on podcast SEO, transcripts and proof.

## Notes
- [Turning podcast episodes into search-ready pages](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/notes/podcast-episodes-into-search-ready-pages): How this site turns one RSS feed into crawlable episode pages, topic hubs and schema.
- [Why Palm Beach County businesses should publish audio with transcripts](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/notes/palm-beach-county-audio-with-transcripts): A transcript workflow for West Palm Beach and Jupiter businesses.
- [Jason Colapietro on press, proof and being cited](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/notes/press-proof-and-being-cited): What Business Insider, TechBullion and Programming Insider published, and why every claim carries a proof link.

## Topics
- [Music IP as a real-world asset](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/topics/music-ip-real-world-assets): Episodes on tokenized music rights that the people who made the work own and earn from.
- [Music royalties and the Vault](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/topics/music-royalties): Episodes on on-chain settlement and payouts, legacy royalty lag, and the Vault.
- [Rights registry and provenance](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/topics/music-rights-registry-and-provenance): Episodes on public records of who made a work: the rights registry, provenance and signatures.
- [Token launches and tokenomics](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/topics/token-launches-and-tokenomics): Episodes on launch failures, token burns, and a launchpad built to pay artists.
- [AI and the music industry](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/topics/ai-and-the-music-industry): Episodes on AI as a creator-side tool, paying artists when AI uses their work, and AI agents.

## Key facts
- Host: Jason Colapietro, founder of Suede AI.
- Built and maintained by Suede AI in West Palm Beach, Florida: https://suedeai.agency/
- Topics: creator ownership infrastructure, programmable IP, music rights, AI product shipping.
- Publisher: Suede AI (also known as Suede Labs), https://suedeai.ai.

## Source and citation guide

- [AI Instructions](https://podcast.suedeai.ai/ai-instructions): Site identity, authoritative sources and citation guidance.
